question: What is the cash position and runway?

beats.line: By the end of September, Diginex held one point eight five million in cash.
beats.headline: $1.85M
beats.action: A single halftone stack of paper coins drops onto a cream chip and settles; a coin-sized cream tag reading '$1.85M' sits beside the black ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] By the end of September, Diginex held one point eight five million in cash.

beats.line: Six months earlier it was three point one one million.
beats.headline: $3.11M → $1.85M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the coin stack shrinks coin by coin; the black ribbon already in place tugs a torn-paper arrow in, pointing down.
beats.delivery: Six months earlier it was three point one one million.

beats.line: Operating burn ran three point nine million over six months. Investing took another eight point eight.
beats.headline: $3.9M + $8.8M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the arrow unrolls into a paper calendar strip; coins slide off it month by month, and an orange string runs from the strip toward the right edge.
beats.delivery: Operating burn ran three point nine million over six months. Investing took another eight point eight.

beats.line: Twelve point seven million was consumed, offset by eleven point four million from warrant exercises.
beats.headline: $12.7M OUT
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the strip curls and a torn strip of paper is taped back across the gap; the orange string stays in place, still running to the right.
beats.delivery: Twelve point seven million was consumed, offset by eleven point four million from warrant exercises.

beats.line: At about one point three million a month, that cash covers one point four months.
beats.headline: 1.4 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the taped strip flattens into a paper runway torn short; a cutout aircraft rolls to the torn end and stops, the orange string still attached.
beats.delivery: [excited] At about one point three million a month, that cash covers one point four months.

beats.line: October's warrant exercise generated thirteen point eight million, strengthening the balance sheet after that snapshot.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the runway folds up into a paper balance sheet; fresh paper coins drop onto it and a cream arrow links them, with a coin-sized tag reading '$13.8M' beside it.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] October's warrant exercise generated thirteen point eight million, strengthening the balance sheet after that snapshot.

beats.line: Survival hinges on capital markets. The company is not yet self-sustaining.
beats.headline: NOT SELF-SUSTAINING
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the balance sheet tilts and a paper hand enters to hold its edge steady; the cream arrow from the coins is already in place.
beats.delivery: Survival hinges on capital markets. The company is not yet self-sustaining.

beats.line: Subscription revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year in the first half.
beats.headline: +293% YOY
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the balance sheet folds into a paper bar chart rising beside the returning coin stack; an orange string runs from the stack to the right edge.
beats.delivery: Subscription revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year in the first half.

beats.line: The next six to nine months are critical. Later results will show whether runway extends.
beats.headline: NEXT 6-9 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bar chart splits into two paper calendar pages landing beside the coin stack; the orange string holds, and a paper hand taps the second page.
beats.delivery: The next six to nine months are critical. Later results will show whether runway extends.
